{{Top|leg}}
'''Flexiplast''' was one of the materials used on signs during mass protests during the [[Funeral of Cha Niathal]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[43 ABY]]. It was also used to protect some parts of [[Droid/Legends|droids]], like the storage compartment and servos in [[LesTech]]'s [[PackTrack 41LT-R]].
